title: Preserve datasource type and UID in trace correlation queries
answers: Show context says No more logs available after clicking Logs for this span
Datasource-specific log context controls are missing after navigating from a trace
What datasource reference must trace-to-logs and trace-to-metrics queries carry?
body:
Symptom: After clicking Logs for this span, Show context displays “No more logs available” instead of surrounding logs and datasource-specific controls.
Root cause: public/app/features/explore/TraceView/createSpanLink.tsx:legacyCreateSpanLinkFactory generated inner queries without datasource.type; a UID alone allowed execution but did not reliably identify the plugin.
Fix pattern: Attach datasource: { type, uid } from the target datasource settings to generated logs and metrics queries, including interpolated alternative log queries.
Constraints: Preserve the complete reference with dynamic trace-to-logs queries both enabled and disabled. The Explore pane's datasource UID does not replace the reference required on each inner query.
applies: Explore trace-to-logs and trace-to-metrics link generation, including alternative log queries.
